source.title: Protector's Discarded Shield — live Wowhead Looter item-side disenchanting
source.author: Wowhead Looter aggregate

notes: Unreviewed LIVE item-side mutable Wowhead Looter table, row 1/3 (visible 1-3 stack annotation). Source reports 29 item disenchants, but raw player operations, exact itemLink/bonus, game build, skill, specialization, linked output item ID and material quality rank are missing. The page also previews base ilvl 44 and selectable Adventurer ilvl 227; neither proves disenchant-time item level. Two displayed Eversinging Dust rows MUST NOT be collapsed or assumed to be the same material rank; quantities, per-output zero counts, observed min/max, independent cohort provenance and conditional yield distributions remain unknown. Catalog reference only, never estimator-eligible.
